Both true classes represented; all finite candidate denominators positive

problems.result: 9/20=.45>.05; same population proportions give deterministic failure
problems.counterevidence: Predicted-class interpretation fixes grouping but contradicts explicit printed set/comment; actual code unavailable; joint branch unaffected
problems.impact: Core classwise error-control construction invalid, regardless of short repair or surviving experiments
